name: Funds Cash Flow
definition: Cash movements from or to a fund as a result of investment funds transactions, for example, subscriptions or redemptions.

ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator.name: Exceptional Cash Flow Indicator
ExceptionalCashFlowIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the cash flow is exceptional , eg, extraordinary cash amounts in or out.

FlowDirection.name: Flow Direction
FlowDirection.definition: Specifies the direction of the cash flow from the perspective of the fund.

NetIndicator.name: Net Indicator
NetIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the cash flow is the result of netting.

FundSubscriptionAccountEntry.name: Fund Subscription Account Entry
FundSubscriptionAccountEntry.definition: Account entry which is linked to a fund subscription process.

FundRedemptionAccountEntry.name: Fund Redemption Account Entry
FundRedemptionAccountEntry.definition: Account entry which is linked to a fund redemption process.

RelatedOrder.name: Related Order
RelatedOrder.definition: Trade which is the source for the calculation of the cash flow movements.

NetAssetValueCalculation.name: Net Asset Value Calculation
NetAssetValueCalculation.definition: Net asset value incorporating the net cash flow for a valuation date.

CashFlowQuantity.name: Cash Flow Quantity
CashFlowQuantity.definition: Value and quantity of the cash flow.
